crossRefs.note: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
“For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone…

translations.web: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
translations.bsb: For then You would count my steps, but would not keep track of my sin.
translations.kjv: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
translations.asv: But now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?
